name: Rush Creek Lodge & Spa at Yosemite
pros: True forest setting in tall pines. Real indoor backup. On-site lodging makes out-of-town guests easy. Modern timber-lodge aesthetic.
cons: ~2.5 hr drive from Clovis. F&B minimums stack on top of rental — total can creep. Snow risk Jan–Feb on the highway.
notes:
**Vibe:** Modern forest lodge at the Yosemite north gate.

**Capacity:** Up to 200.

**Pricing:** ~$3,000–$7,400 venue rental (peak); off-season Nov–Feb likely lower. Get a 200-guest off-season quote that includes F&B minimums.

**Indoor backup:** ✅ — lodge interiors.

**Lodging on-site:** ✅ — full resort + spa.

**Verify before booking:** F&B minimum at 200 guests in Nov–Feb, snow/road-closure policy, ceremony space capacity if held indoors.

name: The Pines Resort
pros: Strongest local Sierra+water combination. On-site lodging. Lakefront pergola ceremony site. Off-season pricing should be friendly.
cons: Lake/mountain elevation — Jan/Feb road and snow risk. Verify true indoor space at 200 guests.
notes:
**Vibe:** Lakefront ponderosa pines in the Yosemite mountains — "the only lakefront venue in the Yosemite mountains."

**Capacity:** Up to 300.

**Pricing:** ~$4,900–$20,000 venue packages; Nov–Feb should land at the low end.

**Indoor backup:** ✅ — resort has indoor event spaces.

**Lodging on-site:** ✅ — full resort.

**Verify:** Indoor reception capacity at 200, off-season package details.

name: Evergreen Lodge at Yosemite
pros: Cabin-in-the-pines aesthetic exactly matching the woodland brief. On-site lodging in cabins. Real indoor space.
cons: ~2.5 hr drive from Clovis. Books out even off-season — inquire early.
notes:
**Vibe:** Cabin-in-the-pines lodge with rustic-tavern feel.

**Capacity:** Up to 200.

**Pricing:** ~$5,000–$7,400 peak rental; lower in Nov–Feb.

**Indoor backup:** ✅

**Lodging on-site:** ✅ — cabins.

**Verify:** F&B minimum, snow-policy on the road in, peak ceremony cabin availability.

name: Tenaya at Yosemite (formerly Tenaya Lodge)
pros: Polished Sierra resort surrounded by forest. Big capacity (400). On-site lodging.
cons: F&B minimum (~$22.7k for 'Three Salons' at 200 guests) likely blows the total budget. Smaller spaces cap below 200.
notes:
**Vibe:** Polished Sierra resort tucked into the forest at the Yosemite south gate.

**Capacity:** Up to 400.

**Pricing:** Rental $800–$5,000 for smaller spaces; for 200 guests you'll be in 'Three Salons' or the Pavilion with a ~$22,700 F&B minimum.

**Indoor backup:** ✅

**Lodging on-site:** ✅

**Verify:** Whether any sub-200 package fits the budget. Otherwise likely a 'pass.'

name: Shaver Lake Village Hotel
pros: Closest true alpine-forest venue to Clovis (~1 hr). Sierra National Forest setting. Hotel rooms on-site.
cons: Real snow risk at 5,300 ft Dec–Feb. Capacity at 200 needs verification.
notes:
**Vibe:** Small alpine village hotel in Sierra National Forest.

**Capacity:** Verify — listed wedding spaces are modest.

**Pricing:** ~$5,000 ceremony, ~$5,000 reception.

**Indoor backup:** ✅

**Lodging on-site:** ✅

**Verify:** Reception capacity at 200, snow contingency, off-season package.

name: Mission Ranch
pros: Real Carmel coastal vibe: sheep meadow + ocean views of Point Lobos and Carmel River Beach. Historic barn for reception. Extraordinarily low rental ($2.5k–4k). Hotel rooms on-site. Clint Eastwood-owned and lovingly maintained.
cons: Caps at 180 outdoor / 168 indoor — must trim guest list. In-house catering required (Carmel pricing is the wild card). $250 setup fee + $2,500 security deposit on top.
notes:
**Vibe:** 22-acre historic ranch in Carmel with sheep grazing meadow and Pacific Ocean views.

**Capacity:** 180 ceremony outdoor / **168 indoor reception** (Patio Barn).

**Pricing:** Rental $2,500–$4,000 + $1.50/person setup + $250 setup fee + $2,500 security deposit. Their catering and florist required — get a 150-guest food quote.

**Indoor backup:** ✅ — historic Patio Barn with glass doors to the meadow.

**Lodging on-site:** ✅ — hotel rooms on the property.

**Verify:** Total catering quote for 150, winter-month availability, mandatory florist costs.

**Sources:** [wedding-spot.com](https://www.wedding-spot.com/venue/1487/mission-ranch/), [missionranchcarmel.com](https://www.missionranchcarmel.com/weddings-and-events.htm)

name: Carmel Fields by Wedgewood Weddings
pros: Best price-to-vibe ratio on the coast. Off-peak (Dec–March) pricing baked in. All-inclusive package: meal, 5hr event, linens, planning, bartending, cake-cutting, insurance. Spanish Colonial setting at the gateway to Carmel Valley with panoramic views.
cons: Not on-site lodging. Capacity around 250 — verify your final count fits. 'All-inclusive' is a price floor; upgrades add up.
notes:
**Vibe:** Spanish Colonial on rolling fields, panoramic views across Monterey County. Coastal-adjacent rather than oceanfront.

**Capacity:** ~250.

**Pricing:** Off-peak (Dec–March) ~$9,040 starting; peak ~$8,657. Package includes meal, 5-hr event, tables/chairs/linens, planning + day-of coordination, bartending + event staff, cake-cutting, insurance, and Bliss Benefits.

**Indoor backup:** ✅

**Lodging on-site:** ❌

**Verify:** Real total for 150 guests with the food tier you want, what 'Premier' or 'Elite' upgrades cost vs Classic.

**Sources:** [theknot.com](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/carmel-fields-by-wedgewood-weddings-carmel-ca-423028), [bridespedia.com](https://bridespedia.com/carmel-fields-by-wedgewood-weddings-cost/)

name: Hyatt Carmel Highlands Inn
pros: Dramatic oceanside cliff setting above the Pacific. Indoor + outdoor venue (Gazebo Deck + Oceanside Ballroom). Hotel rooms on-site.
cons: Only fits **150 with a dance floor** — must trim significantly. Carmel hotel F&B costs add up fast on top of $13.5k rental.
notes:
**Vibe:** Oceanside cliff hotel with Pacific views.

**Capacity:** 150 with dance floor.

**Pricing:** Gazebo Deck + Oceanside Ballroom $13,500 venue.

**Indoor backup:** ✅

**Lodging on-site:** ✅

**Verify:** F&B minimum and per-person pricing — Carmel hotels typically $150–250/pp.

name: Folktale Winery & Vineyards
pros: Working winery with vineyard rows, rose garden, barrel room. Six distinct event spaces. Capacity up to 200 indoor / 800 outdoor.
cons: **Blows budget at 200 guests.** Rental $7.5–25k + ceremony fee $2.5–5k + F&B $75–250/person. At 200 guests this is $25k+ before photo/flowers/etc.
notes:
**Vibe:** Working winery in Carmel Valley with vineyards, gardens, and a French-country barrel room. Vineyard/garden aesthetic, near the coast (not oceanfront).

**Capacity:** Up to 200 indoor / 300 indoor (varies by space) / 800 outdoor.

**Pricing:** Rental $7,500–$25,000 + ceremony fee $2,500–$5,000 + F&B $75–$250/person.

**Indoor backup:** ✅ — Vineyard House + Barrel Room.

**Lodging on-site:** ❌

**Budget reality:** Only realistic at 150 guests + low-tier package + off-season — and even then it's tight. Consider only if Folktale specifically is a dream venue.

**Sources:** [folktalewinery.com](https://www.folktalewinery.com/wedding-events/), [herecomestheguide.com](https://www.herecomestheguide.com/wedding-venues/northern-california/folktale-winery-vineyards)

name: Wolf Lakes Park
pros: Closest woodland/lakefront option (~30 min from Clovis). 40-acre lake with pergola ceremony site. All-inclusive package keeps total cost down. Fits 200 comfortably.
cons: **No real indoor reception space** — pavilion is covered but open-air. Significant rain/cold risk Nov–Feb without true indoor backup. No on-site lodging.
notes:
**Vibe:** 40-acre lake with pergola ceremony site and covered pavilion reception. Local woodland/lakefront feel.

**Capacity:** 100–500+ in the Lakeside/Garden spaces.

**Pricing:** ~$4,000 venue for 50 guests then ~$80/person package including in-house catering, coordinator, tables/chairs/linens/dinnerware. For 200 guests ≈ $20,000 all-in.

**Indoor backup:** ⚠️ No dedicated indoor reception space — pavilion is covered outdoor only. Confirm rain plan directly.

**Lodging on-site:** ❌

**Verify:** What happens if it rains heavily in Nov–Feb — is there *any* fully-enclosed building, or just the pavilion?

name: Hidden Hollow Events
pros: All-inclusive (catering, flowers, DJ, rentals) keeps planning simple. Hillside garden vibe with greenery. Grand Ballroom indoor space. Local (~45 min from Clovis).
cons: Capacity not published — must confirm 200 fits. No on-site lodging. All-inclusive can be a budget squeeze depending on which tier they quote for 200.
notes:
**Vibe:** Hillside garden estate with greenery — woodland-adjacent rather than deep forest, not coastal.

**Capacity:** Not published — confirm directly.

**Pricing:** All-inclusive packages starting around $17,695 (per Breezit); includes catering, flowers, DJ, rentals.

**Indoor backup:** ✅ — The Grand Ballroom.

**Lodging on-site:** ❌

**Verify:** Real 200-guest off-season quote (the $17,695 may be for a smaller count), Grand Ballroom capacity, whether flowers/DJ tier can be downgraded if you're handling those separately.

name: Harris Ranch Inn & Restaurant
pros: Big capacity (120–350+). Garden Ballroom + Outdoor Courtyard for ceremony and reception. 153 rooms on-site for out-of-town guests. Mid-way between Clovis and the coast on I-5.
cons: **Doesn't match the woodland/forest/coastal aesthetic** — hacienda-style resort surrounded by cattle ranches and farmland. Pricing requires direct inquiry; no public off-season rates.
notes:
**Vibe:** Hacienda-style resort with landscaped Outdoor Courtyard and Garden Ballroom.

**Capacity:** 120 to 350+.

**Pricing:** Gold / Platinum / Signature packages — only via inquiry. Call 559-935-0717.

**Indoor backup:** ✅ — Garden Ballroom.

**Lodging on-site:** ✅ — 153 rooms.

**Verdict:** Strong on logistics, but the setting is the opposite of woodland/coastal. Worth a tour only if you decide the aesthetic doesn't matter.

**Sources:** [harrisranch.com](https://www.harrisranch.com/weddings), [theknot.com](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/harris-ranch-inn-and-restaurant-coalinga-ca-223590)

name: Wonder Valley Ranch Resort
pros: Closest 'resort with everything' option (~30 min from Clovis). Oak-shaded foothill setting. Chapel + pond + cabins on-site. Real indoor backup. Fits 200+ easily.
cons: More 'ranch resort' than wild forest. Confirm starting package against current pricing.
notes:
**Vibe:** Oak-shaded foothill ranch resort with chapel, pond, and cabins.

**Capacity:** Up to 350.

**Pricing:** Starter package ~$11,664.

**Indoor backup:** ✅

**Lodging on-site:** ✅

**Verify:** Off-season pricing, full package vs base rental, indoor reception space at 200.

name: Evanelle Vineyards
pros: Wooded vineyard with mature trees and barn-style reception. Flat venue fee (~$6,600) leaves room for everything else. Local (~45 min from Clovis). Big capacity.
cons: Vineyard, not deep forest — the 'woods' feel comes from tree-lined edges. No on-site lodging. Need to confirm exactly what the flat fee covers vs add-ons.
notes:
**Vibe:** Rustic wooded vineyard with mature trees and a barn-style reception space.

**Capacity:** Up to 400.

**Pricing:** $6,600 flat venue fee.

**Indoor backup:** ✅

**Lodging on-site:** ❌

**Verify:** What's included in the flat fee (catering, rentals, coordinator) vs extra; off-season rate.

name: The Manor Estate
pros: Cheap starter package (~$5,722). Big capacity. Wine-country setting close to home.
cons: Primary draw is the outdoor estate — verify indoor reception capacity at 200. No on-site lodging. Less truly woodsy than Evanelle.
notes:
**Vibe:** Wine-trail estate with outdoor lawn + indoor reception.

**Capacity:** Up to 1000 listed (verify what that actually means for a 200-seated reception).

**Pricing:** Starting package ~$5,722.

**Indoor backup:** ✅ (verify size).

**Lodging on-site:** ❌

**Verify:** Real indoor capacity at a plated dinner for 200, exact package inclusions.

name: Casa Del Rio
pros: Local (~15 min). Lodge-inspired architecture around a pond. Grand hall + alfresco spaces. Capacity 250.
cons: Per-person pricing means total can creep — must pin down a 200-guest number before getting attached. No on-site lodging. More 'landscaped' than 'forest.'
notes:
**Vibe:** Lodge-style architecture around a pond, in-town Fresno but landscaped with natural beauty.

**Capacity:** Up to 250.

**Pricing:** Package-based per person — get a 200-guest quote.

**Indoor backup:** ✅ — grand hall.

**Lodging on-site:** ❌

**Verify:** Exact per-person package tiers and what each includes.

name: China Peak Mountain Resort
pros: Extraordinary value: starts at $5,000 for a 48-hour private resort buyout including all food, staff, coordinator, rentals. 200-guest capacity. 48-room Inn on-site. 1,500-acre alpine forest exactly matching the woodland brief.
cons: **Dealbreaker for our date window:** they only host weddings June–September. Nov–Feb the resort is operating as an active ski mountain. Would require shifting to summer/early fall.
notes:
**Vibe:** 1,500-acre ski resort transformed for summer weddings — full alpine forest setting, 60 mi NE of Fresno.

**Capacity:** Up to 200.

**Pricing:** Starts at $5,000 for a 48-hour buyout including food, staff, rentals, coordinator, bridal/groom suites. Group lodging discounts 10–20%.

**Indoor backup:** ✅ — full lodge.

**Lodging on-site:** ✅ — 48-room Inn.

**Why passed:** Wedding season is June–September only; Nov–Feb date window doesn't work. Keep on file in case the date window shifts.

**Sources:** [chinapeakweddings.com](https://www.chinapeakweddings.com/), [theknot.com](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/china-peak-mountain-resort-lakeshore-ca-996152)
